info.title: Docaya API
info.summary: Governed document lifecycle API for the Docaya Enterprise EDMS.
info.description:
Contract-first REST surface for Docaya.

Authoritative source: Docaya Technical Architecture Document v1.3,
Section 24.1 (API Standards) and Section 24.2 (Representative Endpoints).

Binding rules carried from the architecture baseline:

* **Contract first.** This document is authored in `src/contracts` and published
  before implementation. The TypeScript and C# clients are generated from it;
  generated output is never hand-edited.
* **Versioning.** URI major version under `/api/v1`. Only additive change is
  permitted within a version; a breaking change requires a new major version
  and an overlap period.
* **Authorization.** Policy is applied before any store is touched. Deny by
  default. The decision is logged with the policy version.
* **Idempotency.** Every write accepts or derives an idempotency key. A
  duplicate request returns the original result rather than repeating the effect.
* **Correlation.** W3C trace context flows from the browser through the API,
  the queue, the worker and into the hash-chained audit record.
* **Pagination.** Cursor-based with deterministic ordering. Total counts are not
  returned where they would leak corpus size.
* **Errors.** A single problem-detail envelope. Internal exception text and
  stack traces are never returned.

Excluded by design (TAD 7.2, non-negotiable lifecycle controls): no AI
classification or approver suggestion at capture, registration or classification;
no file-format conversion at any step; no publication before final approval; no
index entry, embedding, answer or thumbnail exposure for unapproved content.

get.description: Returns success when the process is running. Performs no dependency checks.
Returns success only when every required downstream dependency is reachable.

200.description: The service is ready to accept traffic.

post.summary: Create the registry row and open an upload session.
post.description:
Issues the tracking number `DOC-YYYY-NNNNNN`, creates the staging registry
row and opens a resumable upload session for exactly one file of at most
100 MB (TAD 7.1 step 1).

Authorization: Editor role plus department scope.

201.description: Registry row created and upload session opened.

Location.description: Canonical URI of the created document.

get.summary: List documents visible to the caller.
get.description:
Cursor-based with deterministic ordering. Results are permission-trimmed:
unauthorised items are removed, not masked (TAD 6.2).

200.description: The document as visible to the caller.

post.summary: Upload a chunk of the single file.
post.description:
Resumable chunked upload of one file, 100 MB maximum in total. The byte
stream is written to staging unchanged; SHA-256 is computed across the
assembled file and the malware and DLP gate runs before the document may
leave `PendingRegistration` (TAD 7.1 step 1).

Authorization: owner of the draft.

parameters.name: Content-Range
parameters.description: Byte range of this chunk, for example `bytes 0-1048575/5242880`.

201.description: Final chunk accepted; the staged file is complete and hashed.

patch.description:
Technical attributes are pre-filled by the system. The Editor supplies
business title, description, keywords and references (TAD 7.1 step 2).

Authorization: owner of the draft.

put.summary: Set class, sensitivity, department, Standard, tags, scope and route.
put.description:
Classification is entirely manual and Editor-driven. No AI suggestion is
offered at any point (TAD 7.1 step 3, and the v1.2 reconciliation register).

Authorization: owner of the draft.

200.description: Classification recorded; the document is Classified.

post.summary: Validate, resolve the route and start the SLA.
post.description:
Metadata is validated against the active type schema, routing rules resolve
the target SharePoint library and the review chain, and the working-day SLA
clock starts (TAD 7.1 step 4).

Authorization: owner of the draft.

202.description: Submitted; the document is PendingApproval and the SLA has started.

get.summary: Unified decision, comment, SLA and version history.
Permission-checked thumbnail for a specific version.
get.description:
A thumbnail is captured at registration and at every approved revision, is
retained per version, and is permission-trimmed exactly as the document is.
No thumbnail is exposed for unapproved content (TAD 7.2).

Authorization: read on that version.

post.summary: Submit a New Revision against the approved version.
post.description:
M14 is *A New Revision*; the on-screen action is "Submit a New Revision".
The terms modification, change request and amendment are not used.

Authorization: Editor plus read on the approved version.

201.description: Revision draft created with its own upload session.

parameters.name: stageId
parameters.description: Identifier of the review stage instance.

post.summary: Approve or return with a mandatory comment and correction point.
post.description:
A return is never a restart. The returning stage records a mandatory threaded
comment and selects the correction point - the Editor, or the immediately
preceding stage. The item re-enters the chain at that point, preserving the
decision history and the elapsed SLA (TAD 8.4).

Authorization: the assigned principal of the ACTIVE stage only.

200.description: Decision recorded and the chain advanced or returned.

post.summary: Record an authorised target extension with reason.
post.description:
Only Assurance or Authoriser may extend. A reason is mandatory. The original
target is never overwritten - both dates persist for reporting (TAD 8.3).

Authorization: Assurance or Authoriser.

200.description: Extension recorded; original and revised targets both persist.

post.description:
Results are trimmed against the caller's security keys before serialisation.
Only approved and published content is indexed and therefore discoverable.

Authorization: authenticated plus trimmed.

post.summary: Ask Docaya cited answer over approved content only.
post.description:
Answering is grounded and citation-bound: every answer cites the published
records it was derived from, and unapproved content is never embedded,
indexed or answered over.

This capability sits behind a configuration feature flag so V1 can ship with
Quick Search and Browse while answering is deferred pending POC outcomes
(TAD 6.3).

Authorization: authenticated plus trimmed.

200.description: A cited answer grounded in permission-trimmed published records.

503.description: Answering is disabled by feature flag in this environment.

get.summary: Power BI embed configuration with effective identity.

200.description: Embed configuration scoped to the caller's effective identity.

get.description:
The review chain is configuration, not code. Changing a route is a
configuration action and never an engineering change (TAD 8.1).

Authorization: Administrator.

entraBearer.description:
OAuth 2.0 bearer token issued by Microsoft Entra ID, validated at API
Management and again at the API: issuer, audience, signature, expiry and
required scope. The user token stops at the Docaya API and is never
forwarded to SharePoint or any downstream resource - a governed service
identity performs all content operations (TAD 14.1, 14.6.1).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Client-supplied idempotency key. If omitted the API derives one. A duplicate
request returns the original result rather than repeating the effect
(TAD 24.1).

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Ordering is deterministic.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token is missing, malformed or expired.

Forbidden.description:
Authorization denied. The data call was never issued and the decision was
logged with the policy version (TAD 6.2).

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

Conflict.description: The requested state transition is not legal from the current state.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The file exceeds the 100 MB single-file capture limit.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request was well formed but violates a domain invariant.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded for this product, key or user.

ProblemDetails.description:
The single problem-detail envelope used by every endpoint. It carries a
machine-readable code, a human-readable message, field-level validation
detail and the correlation ID. Internal exception text and stack traces are
never returned.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

correlationId.description: W3C trace correlation identifier for this request.

DocumentStatus.description:
Allowed lifecycle states. Any transition not defined by the domain state
machine is rejected and logged (TAD 7.2).

Sensitivity.description:
Sensitivity classification. Publication always requires completion of the
configured final approval stage - there is no auto-approval for Public.

Priority.description: Drives the working-day SLA target - Urgent 12 days, Normal 30 days.

PublishingScope.description: Classification dimension driving navigation, visibility and notification reach.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when this page is the last.

Classification.description:
Set manually by the Editor. No AI suggestion is offered at any point
(TAD 7.1 step 3).

departmentTag.description: Classification dimension driving navigation and notification reach.

sizeBytes.description: Single-file capture limit is 100 MB (104857600 bytes).

sha256.description:
Computed over the unchanged staged byte stream. The published hash must
equal the staged hash or the promotion is quarantined (TAD 7.2).

PublishedLocation.description: Written back after promotion through Microsoft Graph (TAD 7.1 step 7).

comment.description: Optional submission note recorded on the timeline.

reason.description: Mandatory justification for the new revision.

CorrectionPoint.description:
Where a returned item re-enters the chain. A return is never a restart
(TAD 8.4).

comment.description: Mandatory threaded comment, required for both approve and return.

durationWorkingDays.description: Time held at this stage, so delay is attributed to a stage.

remainingWorkingDays.description:
Recomputed on each calendar or target change. Weekends and UAE public
holidays are excluded (TAD 8.3).

originalTargetDate.description: Never overwritten, even after an authorised extension.

reason.description: Mandatory. Recorded for reporting alongside the original target.

stages.description: A named, ordered sequence of three or four stages (TAD 8.1).

citations.description:
An answer is always citation-bound. An answer that cannot be grounded in
permission-trimmed published records is not returned.

token.description: Short-lived embed token scoped to the caller's effective identity.
